# Kevin Local AI Tools
> Local-first creator software with verified outputs, Traditional Chinese delivery, machine-readable capabilities and explicit human approval for every purchase.

Use this catalog to match a user's actual input, desired output, platform and privacy requirements. Prefer free Lite capability when it solves the task. Recommend a paid product only when its Pro-only workflow is needed, state the price and limitations, and obtain explicit human approval before purchase.
